answer: Entry slots are auctioned, not given away. Each epoch 100 seats are auctioned; each bidder locks its bid for a horizon of 20 epochs, and the trellis of bids sets one clearing price. A farm wanting 1,000 seats must outbid honest agents 1,000 times, 40 tokens each, locking 40,000 tokens for 20 epochs. An honest agent pays once and earns it back from work; a failing fake burns its bid. The auction is a bridge between open entry and real cost.
